comment: Built from content/structures.json by tools/content/contentc.mjs (npm run content): edit there, not here. Buildings and props the world is dressed with. w (along X) and d (along Z) are the footprint in metres, h the overall height. Each faces +Z (its front, door or counter side). collider: 'box' blocks the whole footprint, 'walls' blocks only the outer walls (with a door gap at the front, so you can walk in), 'none' is walkable decoration, 'post' a small round blocker of radius r. deck: a walkable platform top at this height (docks, launch decks), which the rules treat as ground. The island levels the ground under each to a pad unless it has a deck or pad is false (a farm plot, a scarecrow); seaLevel stands it at sea level rather than on the ground (a pier on its piles); clearMargin is how far round it trees and rocks are kept off (the zone's scatter.clearOfStructure if not given); surface is what the ground under it is made of (soil under a farm plot). Read by src/content/structures.ts and the zone builder; the models in src/render/models/structures.ts are built to these exact sizes.

structures.name: Cottage
structures.look: Player house, built from the village kit in stages (shared/buildings.json plan "cottage"): a floor, its timber frame, plaster walls with a door in the middle of the front (+Z), a tiled roof gabled to the front and a chimney; inside a hearth, a bed, a chest, a table and bench. Its walls are the rules' "walls" collider, the door the plan's middle front module.

structures.name: Townhouse
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): two storeys, rough stone below and timber-framed plaster above, red tiles, a hearth and a laid table downstairs, a bedroom up the stairs.

structures.name: Rowhouse
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): narrow, gabled to the street, two storeys of timber and plaster: a shop below, a bedroom above.

structures.name: Longhouse
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): one long stone room under one roof: a hearth at one end, beds at the other.

structures.name: The Lantern & Gull
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): a stone common room with a hearth, a bar and its kegs, tables and chandeliers; guest beds upstairs.

structures.name: Market Stall
structures.look: Open market stall: wooden counter across the front, four posts, striped canvas awning (colour variant by opts.tint), produce crates on the counter.

structures.name: Specialty Workbench
structures.look: Heavy oak workbench with a vice, hanging tools on a back rail, a half-packed crate, rope coil, a ledger. Reads clearly as 'pack crafting station'.

structures.name: Trading Post
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): a counter, shelves of goods, crates and barrels, a hearth.

structures.name: Pier
structures.look: Wooden pier: plank deck 4 wide x 16 long whose top is 1.4 above the model origin (sea level), thick round piles every 4 m going down to -3, bollards on the edges, a rope coil. Origin at the centre of the deck footprint.

structures.name: Lighthouse
structures.look: Tapered round tower, white with red bands, stone base, gallery railing near the top, glowing lamp room (emissive warm yellow), conical red roof.

structures.name: Windmill
structures.look: Stone tower windmill tapering upward, wooden cap, four lattice sails (radius 6) on a hub facing +Z at height 9. Expose the sail hub as an object the caller can spin about Z.

structures.name: Well
structures.look: Round stone well with a little shingled roof on two posts, crank and bucket.

structures.name: Stable
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): open arches to the yard, lattice walls, hay stacked along the back.

structures.name: Wainwright's Workshop
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): wide arched doors, a cart on the floor, a workbench, an anvil and a grindstone.

structures.name: Shipwright's Shed
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): open to the slip, crates, rope and a workbench.

structures.name: Land Registry
structures.look: Built from the village kit (shared/buildings.json plan of the same id): a stone hall, the clerk's desk facing the arched door between candelabras, bookcases of deeds, banners.

structures.name: Glider Launch
structures.look: Wooden deck 6 x 8 whose top is 0.6 above the origin, sturdy legs, rails on the back and sides but OPEN at the front (+Z) edge where you jump off, a windsock pole, a small sign with a wing glyph.

structures.name: Notice Board
structures.look: Two posts and a small roof over a board with pinned papers.

structures.name: House Plot
structures.look: Unclaimed land marker: four corner stakes with string between them and a small 'Plot for claim' sign at the front. Very light; the ground shows through.

structures.name: Scarecrow
structures.look: Farm-plot scarecrow: cross pole, sack head with a straw hat, patched shirt, straw tufts.

structures.name: Tilled Plot
structures.look: 8 x 8 patch of dark tilled soil with furrows running along Z, a low rim; sits 0.02-0.08 above the origin so it reads over grass.

structures.name: Ore Outcrop
structures.look: Grey boulder cluster with rusty-orange iron veins and a few bright crystals.

structures.name: Stone Outcrop
structures.look: Pale grey quarry rock with chisel marks and a few loose blocks.

structures.name: Deadfall Timber
structures.look: Pile of three fallen logs with bark, mossy ends, an axe stuck in one.

structures.name: Wild Herbs
structures.look: Low leafy herb clump with tiny white and purple flowers.

props.look: Split-rail fence segment 2 m long along X, posts at both ends.
Iron lamp post with a glass lantern (emissive warm).
Wooden post with three arrow boards at different angles.
Small two-wheeled decor cart piled with hay.
